building.title: Blue/green: device sessions move to the new colour only when the old colour stops

events.factual_summary: Evrim fırsatı 'Blue/green: device sessions move to the new colour only when the old colour stops' değerlendirme durumuna geçti (owner).

detail_json.reason: Gates: CI run 34143157871 green on 552a318 (API lint+unit, integration, agent build+tests, browser, web, secret hygiene, recovery supervisor). Production run 4 (docs/evidence/m18-4-qualification-2026-09-07-163343.json): the handoff was never reached - nginx -s reload without -c failed on the recreated edge (real bug, exit 77, api-blue kept serving, 0 device offline polls); fixed in a5bd0e8 (reload -c), suite 42/42, CI pending on 9c9faff.

events.factual_summary: Evrim fırsatı 'Blue/green: device sessions move to the new colour only when the old colour stops' test durumuna geçti (owner).

detail_json.reason: Regression tests: tests/unit/test_broker_drain.py (drain closes 1012 + presence dropped + idempotent; loopback guard 403; draining colour refuses connects 1012; undrain reverses); cloud-release-bluegreen.tests.ps1 42/42 (handoff order, stuck handoff 79 -> rollback, rollback devices-first, interruptions + reconcile); API unit 1844 pass; identity enforcement allowlist updated.

events.factual_summary: Evrim fırsatı 'Blue/green: device sessions move to the new colour only when the old colour stops' geliştirme durumuna geçti (owner).

detail_json.reason: Built on main: services/api/app/broker/{runtime,routes,ws}.py (drain/undrain, health.draining), infra/docker/edge/nginx.conf, infra/docker/docker-compose.prod.yml (edge config on the persistent dir, -c), scripts/cloud/release-cloud-core-bluegreen.sh (handoff_devices, ensure_edge, --reconcile), release-cloud-core.ps1 -StageOnly.

events.factual_summary: Evrim fırsatı 'Blue/green: device sessions move to the new colour only when the old colour stops' tasarım hazır durumuna geçti (owner).

detail_json.reason: Design: two edge upstreams (pagentos_api, pagentos_devices for /v1/devices/connect); the release moves DEVICE authority first - device upstream to the idle colour, the active colour drains (POST /v1/devices/drain, loopback-only: sockets closed 1012, presence dropped, new connects refused), wait until the idle colour's health shows the sessions (exit 79 -> rollback), then HTTP; rollback/--rollback reverse it (undrain first).
